about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A dedicated store for those who choose a healthy lifestyle
about.story_title: The Soil That Shaped Us: The Story of Yathu Arokiyagam
about.our_story_desc: It all began with a simple, quiet patch of earth and a clear vision: to practice Natural Farming.We dug our hands into the soil on our own farm, learning the ancient rhythms of nature and understanding what it truly takes to grow food without stripping the earth of its life. But as our crops grew, our vision expanded. We realized that true health shouldn't be a luxury locked away on a private farm—it needed to be shared. That spark transformed our farming roots into a dedicated food community designed to make both our family and your family healthy, resilient, and sustainable.Today, Yathu Arokiyagam is a dedicated sanctuary for everyone choosing a conscious, healthy lifestyle. We run our store on a promise of absolute honesty. We offer a mix of our own hand-harvested items alongside carefully vetted, healthy products procured from trusted partner farmers.We choose transparency over marketing buzzwords. Not everything on our shelves is certified organic—because we know that many small, traditional farmers cultivate beautifully clean food without expensive certifications. However, every single item passes our strict quality shield: absolutely zero adulteration, zero preservatives, and zero industrial shortcuts.From our nutrient-dense traditional rices and drought-resilient millets to our aromatic wood-pressed oils and mineral-rich natural sweeteners, we bridge the gap between ancestral purity and your busy, modern kitchen. When you eat from Yathu Arokiyagam, you are not just buying groceries; you are supporting a circle of wellness that keeps the soil alive, honors the farmer, and protects your health.
about.mission_desc: Our mission is to bridge the gap between ancient agricultural wisdom and modern lifestyle needs by offering honest, unadulterated, and preservative-free food, while sustaining a transparent ecosystem that honors the health of both the consumer and the soil
about.team_desc: The dedicated people behind Yathu Arokiyagam working to bring healthy, traditional food to your family.
about.value_heritage_desc: We believe that the ultimate answers to modern lifestyle diseases lie in the wisdom of our ancestors. By bringing back native millets, heirloom rices, and unrefined sweeteners, we treat your kitchen as the primary pharmacy. We focus on preventive health through time-tested nutrition.
about.value_wisdom_desc: True wellness isn't a modern invention; it is a heritage we temporarily left behind. We carefully curate traditional ingredients that protected our ancestors' physical stamina for generations. This makes it effortless for your family to return to a natural, time-tested baseline of health.
about.value_dna_desc: Our bodies naturally thrive on the native foods our ancestors cultivated for thousands of years. We bypass synthetic health supplements and processed alternatives. Instead, we offer native superfoods that sync perfectly with your system to build lasting immunity and natural strength.
about.value_vitality_desc: No modern gimmicks. We revive indigenous grains, wood-pressed oils, and ancestral health secrets to help your family live a life of vibrant, natural energy.
about.timeline_2020: The Foundation (Our Roots):The First Seed Sown: Successfully transitioned our private land into a 100% Natural Farming ecosystem, committing to chemical-free soil health.Harvesting Purity: Achieved our first successful harvests of indigenous crops, validating that traditional farming can be both sustainable and bountiful.
about.timeline_2022: Community & Procurement (Expanding the Vision) - The Partner Farmer Network: United with a close-knit circle of trusted, traditional local farmers who share our strict principles of clean cultivation without expensive corporate labels.The Clean-Sourcing Guarantee: Developed our internal vetting protocol to strictly guarantee zero adulteration across every product we source.
about.timeline_2024: The Retail Launch (Yathu Arokiyagam Store) - Opening Our Doors: Launched the dedicated Yathu Arokiyagam flagship store, creating a physical sanctuary for families choosing a conscious, healthy lifestyle.Bringing Back the Heritage: Introduced a fully stocked catalog of ancestral essentials—including cold-pressed Marachekku oils, heirloom rices, native millets, and unrefined sweeteners—making healthy living easily accessible.
about.timeline_2026: Serving thousands of families across Tamil Nadu with naturally grown traditional food delivered to their doorsteps.
